Spacelift grew from 39 to 164 employees between 2021 and 2026, raising $74M along the way, most recently a Series C in July 2025.

## About

Spacelift's platform manages infrastructure lifecycle across tools like Terraform, CloudFormation and Pulumi. Its AI layer adds natural language provisioning and diagnostics for both traditional and AI-driven workflows, targeting enterprises that need to scale secure, compliant infrastructure.

The company has raised $74M, most recently in a Series C in July 2025. Its 164-person team shows steady growth since its 2020 founding.
